research:
I couldn't load the Yahoo Finance page or most article pages because the proxy refused every fetch. Everything below comes from search-result snippets I could not check against the full pages. I have left out all material dated after 2026-09-09.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the Yahoo Finance ETH-USD daily close for 2026-09-30 (https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/ETH-USD/history/). That page would not load (proxy refused), so I could not read the latest close directly.
- 2026-09-08: A Yahoo Finance crypto article said ETH opened at $2,489.84, down 1% from Monday's open. It put the all-time high at $4,953.73, set in August 2025. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/bitcoin-and-ethereum-prices-today-tuesday-september-8-2026-crypto-prices-sliding-as-us-iran-fighting-continues-113441984.html)
- 2026-09-09: Fortune's daily price report put ETH at about $2,488. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-ethereum-09-09-2026/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. ETH is around $2,470 to $2,500, roughly the middle of the $1,500 to $4,000 range, with about three weeks left.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-08/09: ETH was holding near $2,500 ahead of this week's CPI report. [UseTheBitcoin](https://usethebitcoin.com/eth/ethereum-price-september-8-2026/), [Ground News](https://ground.news/article/ethereum-price-analysis-september-8-2026-eth-holds-near-25k-ahead-of-cpi)
- 2026-09-08: US spot ETH ETFs had about $24.3M of net outflows. After a strong jobs report, CME FedWatch reportedly showed more than 60% odds of a 25 bp rate hike. I could not confirm the article's year. [TradersUnion](https://tradersunion.com/news/cryptocurrency-news/show/3272185-ethereum-holds-near-2500/)
- 2026-09-08: Crypto prices were sliding as US-Iran fighting continued. BTC was about $78,968 and ETH about $2,486. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/bitcoin-and-ethereum-prices-today-tuesday-september-8-2026-crypto-prices-sliding-as-us-iran-fighting-continues-113441984.html), [Deepcoin on X](https://x.com/deepcoin_news/status/2097183757757460837/photo/1)
- 2026-09-08: RoboForex had ETH at $2,472, with support at $2,365 and resistance at $2,520. [RoboForex](https://roboforex.com/beginners/analytics/forex-forecast/cryptocurrency/eth-usd-ethereum-forecast-2026-09-08/)
- 2026-09-01 to 09-03: Fortune's prices were about $2,463 (Sep 1), $2,378 (Sep 2) and $2,410 (Sep 3). [Fortune 9/1](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-ethereum-09-01-2026/), [Fortune 9/2](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-ethereum-09-02-2026/), [Fortune 9/3](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-ethereum-09-03-2026/)
- 2026-08-24/25: ETH crossed $2,500 and traded near $2,480 on Aug 25, up about 30% in 7 days. The daily RSI was about 79, which is overbought. [CryptoTimes](https://www.cryptotimes.io/2026/08/24/ethereum-eth-price-at-2500-analysis-predictions-whats-next/), [CoinStats](https://coinstats.app/ai/a/latest-news-for-ethereum)
- 2026-08-19 to 08-21: ETH gained more than 17% in one session (Aug 19, close near $2,250), then hit an intraday high near $2,545 on Aug 21. US spot ETH ETFs had about $697M of inflows, their best week of 2026. ETH also broke above its 200-day moving average, near $2,159. [TokenPost](https://www.tokenpost.com/news/investing/22897), [Pluang](https://pluang.com/en/news-feed/harga-ethereum-kuat-di-atas-2400-setelah-breakout-agustus), [crypto.news](https://crypto.news/ethereum-price-rally-overheats-below-2550-resistance/)
- One price table put ETH at about $1,800 on Aug 31 and about $1,660 on Aug 23. That clashes with the rally reports above, so I treat it as unreliable.

## 4. Base rates
- Trend: ETH was about $1,860 to $1,890 in late July 2026 and about $1,900 before the August breakout. It is now around $2,480, roughly 30% higher in about six weeks. [Decrypt](https://decrypt.co/374653/ethereum-price-stalls-fed-rate-decision), [Bitcoin.com](https://news.bitcoin.com/polymarket-bettors-give-ethereum-just-a-17-shot-at-reaching-3000-in-2026/)
- 2026-09-08: Fortune said ETH was about $1,835 below its level a year earlier, which means it fell about 43% over the year. [Fortune](https://fortune.com/article/price-of-ethereum-09-08-2026/)
- Typical variation (my own calculation, no source): ETH's annualized volatility has historically been about 60 to 80%. Over the 21 days to Sep 30, that works out to a one-standard-deviation move of roughly 14 to 18%, or about ±$350 to $450 from $2,480. Most 3-week periods would therefore end somewhere between about $2,050 and $2,950. Reaching the range edges ($1,500 or $4,000) would take moves of about -40% or +60%, which rarely happen in 3 weeks.
- In the 3 weeks after Aug 19, ETH mostly stayed between about $2,375 and $2,545.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket lists daily "Ethereum price on September 30" and "What price will Ethereum hit in September" markets. [Polymarket Sep 8 example](https://polymarket.com/event/ethereum-price-on-september-8-2026), [Polymarkets mirror](https://polymarkets.co.il/en/market/what-price-will-ethereum-hit-in-september-2026/) I could not find a snapshot of either market dated on or before Sep 9.
- Late July 2026: In a Polymarket "hit $1,000 or $3,000 first" market, $1,000 traded at about 54 cents and $3,000 at about 50 cents, with ETH near $1,860. That snapshot is out of date. [Bitcoin.com](https://news.bitcoin.com/polymarket-bettors-give-ethereum-just-a-17-shot-at-reaching-3000-in-2026/)
- Model-based forecasts, which carry little weight: CoinCodex projected a September average of about $2,338, and Cryptopolitan projected $2,676 to $3,166 for September. [Cryptopolitan](https://www.cryptopolitan.com/ethereum-price-prediction/), [LiteFinance](https://www.litefinance.org/blog/analysts-opinions/ethereum-price-prediction-forecast/)
- I found no Kalshi market or expert forecast for Sep 30 specifically, dated on or before Sep 9.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Around Sep 10 to 11: US August CPI comes out "later this week". I could not confirm the exact date. [UseTheBitcoin](https://usethebitcoin.com/eth/ethereum-price-september-8-2026/)
- Sep 15 to 16: FOMC meeting, with the decision, updated economic projections and the press conference on Sep 16. The Fed is reportedly holding rates at 3.50 to 3.75% under Chair Warsh, and markets were reportedly pricing hike risk. [Federal Reserve](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/2026-september.htm), [CoinGape](https://coingape.com/fomc-meeting-sept-2026-date-schedule-expectations-and-how-to-watch/)
- Ongoing: the US-Iran conflict, which has affected oil and risk sentiment, and daily spot ETH ETF flows, which turned negative on Sep 8.
- Sep 25: the usual quarterly Deribit options expiry on the last Friday of the quarter. This is a general pattern; I did not confirm it for this quarter.
